affected_subject.reason: HypoVault constructor and its totalSupply state are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Constructor sets 1,000,000 shares in totalSupply without minting to any account.

direct_effect.reason: Ghost shares inflate totalSupply, causing over-minting on deposits and under-payment on withdrawals.

safety_relation_basis.reason: ERC-20 invariant totalSupply == sum(balanceOf[]) is stated as intended but violated by phantom shares.

summary: Report identifies HypoVault constructor creating unbacked ghost shares, violating the stated totalSupply invariant and causing dilution and under-payment.
